http_additions.acl: current room host, current accepted entry policy, authenticated current room session
http_additions.precondition: waiting draft; selected members online and setup ready
http_additions.privacy: No identities, edges, resolved classes, eligible counts, card IDs or actor permutations; no-store. Preview is advisory, Start repeats actual complete preflight inside its transaction.
http_additions.unavailable: 503 PACK_UNAVAILABLE for unavailable catalogue; standard existing safe error envelope for authentication/setup/revision failures

operator_surface: Offline/trusted in-process API only; no consumer catalogue mutation or arbitrary JSON/URL upload

catalog_fence.order: global shared/exclusive catalogue fence first, then sorted room locks, then audit/outbox global locks
catalog_fence.dispatch: public/private synchronous enqueue under final shared fence

storage: Additive separate catalogue schema generation1; immutable P02 core and P03 game migrations unchanged
withdrawal: fsynced external metadata-only intent before DB commit; failed commits require failclosed reconciliation; affected pinned games aborted and private clears keep monotonic stream revisions
mutation_receipts: stop/abort retain original MutationResult. advance/pause/resume retain the stored original GameView session/revision and body; final delivery revalidates that specific pinned pack. If text is withdrawn or current read ACL/dependencies fail, current_round is null while all original receipt metadata remains. This explicit safety redaction affects transport only, never overwrites the stored idempotency result or substitutes another session. A committed successful safety mutation remains acknowledged.
rollback: CAS pointer only to verified compatible application-bundled digest, never a revoked revision; process-stopped older-image rollback requires quiesce and retained external ledger; old P03 cannot serve new catalogue activations safely
human_boundary: Trusted named competent independent humans must review exact draft hashes. Ed25519 authenticates their registered keys; operator evidence establishes identity/competence externally. AI cannot establish personhood or self-approve.
public_production_catalogue: NONE;450cards150permode (100neutral public+25private in_person+25private online) remain draft/needs_review; no production bundle admitted
